title: INCENTIVES FOR STAFF
content:
[vc_row disable_element="yes"][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Financial Assistance For Laptops"]The management of ATME College of Engineering are also providing financial assistance to the staff for purchase of laptops, the college shall pay the quoted price to the laptops and later the staff will repay the amount on Installment basis to the college without any interest.[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="INCENTIVES FOR STAFF"][/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_tta_accordion active_section="-1" collapsible_all="true"][vc_tta_section title="1. Laptop Financial Assistance" tab_id="1770973598172-05e302d0-503e"][vc_column_text]
  • College pays laptop cost upfront.
  • Staff repays in interest-free installments.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="2. Textbook Publication Awards (With ATMECE Affiliation)" tab_id="1770973598186-c9841cad-9aa2"][vc_column_text]
  • ₹25,000 – National reputed publisher (ISBN/ISSN).
  • ₹10,000 – International publisher (ISBN/ISSN).
  • ₹5,000 – Regional/Local publisher.
  • ₹2,000 – International book chapter (ISBN/ISSN).
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="3. Journal Publication Incentives" tab_id="1770973670135-abf2787b-fac8"][vc_column_text]
Conditions:
  • Referred journal; from 2nd paper onwards (calendar year).
  • One Scopus paper mandatory for all staff.
  • Research-only faculty: 1 Scopus paper/semester.
  • Approval from Dean (Research) & Head of Institution required.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="4. ATMECE Research Award" tab_id="1770973739458-6da78727-91ea"][vc_column_text]
  • Annual cumulative SNIP ≥ 2.
  • 100% weightage – 1st author.
  • 50% weightage – 2nd author (Ph.D.-related).
  • In collaborations, only one ATMECE faculty eligible (100% weightage).
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="5. Conference Support (Within India)" tab_id="1770973774545-84033010-50f3"][vc_column_text]
Eligibility: Reputed conferences (IEEE/Springer/ASME/ACM, etc.), reputed host institutions, oral presentation only.
 
Support (First Author):
  • SCL + Registration (Max ₹8,000)
  • TA: Sleeper class or ₹3,000 (whichever less)
Key Points:
  • Only one faculty per joint paper.
  • Max 3 conferences/year.
  • Student papers: ₹8,000 registration + TA (Max ₹2,000).
  • Papers must be Scopus/WoS indexed (or ISBN for Humanities).
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="6. Workshops / FDP / STTP / SDP" tab_id="1770973827889-2c05f7f8-9598"][vc_column_text]
Eligibility & Limits:
  • Reputed institutes; preference for AICTE/ISTE (≥5 days).
  • Min. 1 year service.
  • Max 2 programs/year; 2 faculty/department at a time.
Financial Support:
  • SCL + Registration (Max ₹3,000)
  • TA actuals or ₹2,500 (whichever less)
  • FDP outside Mysuru: ₹1,000/day (if no boarding/lodging)
Conditions:
  • Attend preferably during semester break (>2 days).
  • Knowledge dissemination mandatory after FDP outside.
  • Pre-approval required; documents to be submitted within one week after return.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row]
